name: Comprehensive Inter-American Strategy to Combat Threats to Cyber Security (AG/RES. 2004 (XXXIV-O/04))
owner: Organization of American States — Inter-American Committee against Terrorism (CICTE)
description: Comprehensive Inter-American Strategy to Combat Threats to Cyber Security (AG/RES. 2004 (XXXIV-O/04), June 8, 2004). Hemispheric cybersecurity strategy adopted by the OAS General Assembly in June 2004 (AG/RES. 2004 (XXXIV-O/04)), supplemented by CICTE Declarations (2012, 2015) and regional National Cybersecurity Strategy guidance.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Organization of American States — Inter-American Committee against Terrorism (CICTE) (oas.org) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Organization of American States — Inter-American Committee against Terrorism (CICTE) (oas.org).
